target: LOI (%) RPUF literature, same 333-row benchmark as round 1

HistGradientBoosting(learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0) with monotonic_cst +1 on el_P, el_N, total_fr_wtpct, cls_expandable_graphite, cls_intumescent(APP-based), cls_P-N; 0 elsewhere
equal-weight average of round-1 rf and c2 predictions, per fold

selection_rule: highest protocol-B mean; adopt over round-1 rf only if >= 8/10 paired B repeats better AND B ci_lo >= 0.130
exit_triggers: B ci_lo > 0.84 or A mean > 0.84 -> EXIT 5 (not expected)
after_round: if nothing is adopted, LOI round budget has 1 round left (round 3: RDKit descriptors only if time remains, plan §6)
